questions.q: What is the host's name and what is the channel called?
questions.e: In the video: "ovo je kanal Samo Yoga, ja se zovem Zorka" — this is the Samo Yoga channel, my name is Zorka.

questions.q: What equipment is needed for the exercise?
questions.e: In the video: "Ne treba vam dodatna oprema" — you don't need additional equipment.

questions.q: From what position can the exercises be done?
o: From a seated or standing one
questions.e: In the video: "Ove vežbe možete da radite iz sedećeg ili stojećeg položaja" — you can do these exercises from a seated or standing position.

questions.q: Where should the shoulders be lowered?
o: Back and down, away from the ears
questions.e: In the video: "opustite ramena nazad i dole, daleko od ušiju" — relax your shoulders back and down, far from your ears.

questions.q: What is the exercise of opening and closing the palms good for?
o: It stretches the forearms and wrists
questions.e: In the video: "Ova vežba je sjajna jer isteže podlaktice i ručne zglobove" — this exercise is great because it stretches the forearms and wrists.

questions.q: At what angle should the elbows be held?
questions.e: In the video: "Zadržite laktove pod uglom od devedeset stepeni" — keep your elbows at an angle of ninety degrees.

questions.q: What does Zorka say near the end about sensations?
o: You can probably already feel warmth in your hands
questions.e: In the video: "Verovatno već osećate toplinu u rukama" — you probably already feel warmth in your hands.

questions.q: What exercise does she do at the very end?
o: A shoulder stretch, right arm to the left
questions.e: In the video: "Polako možemo da privučemo desnu ruku do leve, istežemo ramena" — slowly we can pull the right arm toward the left, stretching the shoulders.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Sopstveni — one's own.
Dlan — a palm.
Podlaktica — a forearm.
Uvo (pl. uši) — an ear; daleko od ušiju — far from the ears.
Udah — an inhalation; izdah — an exhalation.
Stomak — the belly.
Lopatica — a shoulder blade.
Telo — the body; pored tela — along the body.

questions.q: Verovatno već osećate toplinu u rukama, nastavite da dišete, uskoro smo ___.
questions.e: The adjective agrees with the subject: smo (we) is plural, so gotovi.
Iz + genitive case: iz sedećeg položaja.

questions.q: Zadržite laktove pod ___ od devedeset stepeni.
questions.e: Pod + instrumental (at what angle?): pod uglom.
Ka + dative case: ka nebu — "toward the sky".
U + locative case: u laktovima — "in the elbows".
Od + genitive plural: od ušiju.
Sa + instrumental case: sa izdahom — "on the exhale".

questions.q: Hvala vam što ste mi se pridružili na ovom ___.
questions.e: Na + locative case: na ovom času — "in this class".
